scope: Precisely assigned seven supplementary gates only; no runtime collection/exploit execution

rows.title: libceph: bound pg_{temp,upmap,upmap_items} length to CEPH_PG_MAX_SIZE
rows.source_gate: Ceph/libceph preloaded and CephFS permits user-namespace mounts in the downstream source already reviewed. Needs an accepted monitor OSDMap with a malformed pg_temp/upmap/upmap_items list and a mapping/OSD operation that uses it; not arbitrary unauthenticated TCP input.
rows.protocol_and_impact_limit: The RBD stack trace in the CNA is one reproducer, not a mandatory /dev/rbd requirement: shared libceph OSD-client calc_target invokes ceph_pg_to_up_acting_osds for CephFS too. A tenant can select/control the monitor/cluster it mounts and the corresponding credentials/protocol negotiation. No host cluster credentials or block-device delegation are inherently required; actual deployment/exploit remains unmeasured.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; exact deployed workload and trigger success unknown

rows.title: ceph: reject export_targets ranks >= CEPH_MAX_MDS in mdsmap decode
rows.source_gate: Same CephFS mount/module gate; malicious monitor must supply a validly processed MDSMap containing out-of-range export_targets ranks. check_new_map processes the map against old MDS sessions/rank state.
rows.protocol_and_impact_limit: CephFS metadata/MDS operation and the applicable map/session transition are material prerequisites; merely opening a Ceph socket or using RBD alone does not establish this MDS-client stack-bitmap path. Attacker-controlled monitor/session setup is a tenant-configurable protocol condition, not initial-user-namespace privilege.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; exact deployed workload and trigger success unknown

rows.title: libceph: reject buckets with mismatched CRUSH ids
rows.source_gate: Same Ceph/libceph/userns-mount gate. A malformed monitor-provided CRUSH/OSDMap must pass decoding with bucket id/slot mismatch, then selection of a uniform source bucket/replica must use the aliased workspace.
rows.protocol_and_impact_limit: Requires controlled cluster-map contents and an OSD-placement operation. Shared libceph mapper used by CephFS; no separate delegated RBD device or operator-only kernel module is identified. Peer/auth setup belongs to the controlled mount, not a claim that any remote peer can inject a trusted map.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; exact deployed workload and trigger success unknown

rows.title: ipvs: do not propagate one-packet flag to synced conns
rows.source_gate: IP_VS=m and required schedulers/helpers are explicitly preloaded. IPVS generic-netlink IPVS_CMD_NEW_DAEMON is GENL_UNS_ADMIN_PERM; synchronization sockets and chosen multicast interface use ipvs->net. Tenant namespace CAP_NET_ADMIN can configure its own sync backup/source, services and destinations.
rows.protocol_and_impact_limit: Needs an imported/synced connection created before its destination, later binding to destination flags containing ONE_PACKET, followed by expiry/lookup. Ordinary unsynchronized IPVS traffic is insufficient. No initial-network-namespace-only restriction found in the reviewed start_sync_thread/command path.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; exact deployed workload and trigger success unknown

rows.title: net: ipv6: clear suppressed fib6 rule result
rows.source_gate: CONFIG_IPV6_MULTIPLE_TABLES=y; fib6_rules registers per-netns policy state. Namespace CAP_NET_ADMIN can install own routing rules with suppress selectors; ordinary local lookup/traffic can consume the result. No extra unpreloaded module or physical device identified.
rows.protocol_and_impact_limit: Requires suppressed route followed by no replacement result; not every IPv6 route lookup. Primary evidence is stale/released route and next reference put; architect owns whether that supports the requested escalation tier.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; exact deployed workload and trigger success unknown

rows.title: netfilter: nf_nat_sip: reload possible stale data pointer
rows.source_gate: NF_CONNTRACK_SIP/NF_NAT_SIP=m and both are explicitly preloaded. Tenant namespace CAP_NET_ADMIN can configure conntrack helper/NAT treatment of its own traffic through the preloaded nftables/iptables control path.
rows.protocol_and_impact_limit: Needs SIP helper assignment, NAT/reply with forced_dport behavior, and a cloned skb that skb_ensure_writable reallocates. Module presence alone does not apply the helper to all SIP traffic; primary analysis specifically excludes fragmented skbs here because conntrack SIP linearizes them. Claimed TCP branch is guarded defensively, not evidence of a proven TCP trigger.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; exact deployed workload and trigger success unknown

rows.title: NFSv4: remove callback IDR entry on client allocation failure
rows.source_gate: NFS client/v4 modules explicitly preloaded; downstream NFS allows user-namespace mounting. nfs_get_cb_ident_idr explicitly allocates identifiers only for version4 minorversion0 and stores them in the mount/client network namespace cb_ident_idr. Tenant can select a controlled NFSv4.0 server and arrange matching callback reachability.
rows.protocol_and_impact_limit: Requires later client-initialization failure after IDR insertion, then a callback lookup by the stale id; ordinary successful mounts and v4.1+ sessions do not establish this defect. A controlled server alone is not proof of reliable failure induction. Source analysis confirms namespace/mount availability, not that the allocation-failure/callback exploit was reproduced.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; exact deployed workload and trigger success unknown
